top_stories.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
top_stories.summary: A maximum-severity authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76460) with a CVSS score of 10 has been discovered in Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE). The flaw affects API endpoint authentication in the ISE platform, which is widely used for network access control and identity management.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Disrupts EvilTokens Device Code Phishing Service
top_stories.summary: Microsoft seized 50 websites and disabled over 150 domains to disrupt EvilTokens, a phishing-as-a-service platform targeting Microsoft 365 accounts. The operation focused on device code phishing, a technique that abuses OAuth device authentication flows to steal tokens and bypass MFA protections.

top_stories.title: Rogue external MFA providers can steal passwords during logins
top_stories.summary: Security researchers developed an attack technique that allows hackers with privileged access to register a rogue external MFA provider, enabling password theft during legitimate login attempts. The attack targets the external MFA provider registration mechanism, exploiting privileged access to intercept credentials mid-authentication flow.

top_stories.title: EvilTokens PhaaS disrupted after compromising 12,000 Microsoft accounts
top_stories.summary: Microsoft's Digital Crimes Unit disrupted the EvilTokens Phishing-as-a-Service (PhaaS) platform after it compromised more than 12,000 Microsoft accounts across over 10,000 organizations. The operation targeted session token theft, a technique used to bypass multi-factor authentication by hijacking authenticated sessions.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Takes Down EvilTokens Device-Code Phishing Service Tied to 12,000 Inbox Compromises
top_stories.summary: Microsoft executed a court-authorized takedown of the EvilTokens device-code phishing service, which was linked to approximately 12,000 inbox compromises. The service exploited OAuth device code authentication flows using AI throughout the attack chain, targeting identity tokens to bypass traditional authentication controls.

news.title: F5 patches BIG-IP APM zero-day flaw exploited in RCE attacks
news.summary: F5 has released security updates to patch a critical zero-day vulnerability in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) that was being actively exploited in remote code execution attacks. BIG-IP APM is a widely used access management and authentication proxy solution, making this vulnerability directly relevant to IAM infrastructure security.

news.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI hack, data theft in PeopleSoft zero-day breach
news.summary: ShinyHunters claims it breached FBI systems by exploiting a zero-day vulnerability in Oracle PeopleSoft, an enterprise platform used for HR and identity management functions. The attackers report gaining access to internal services and stealing sensitive data on employees and job applicants.

news.title: AI Agents Are Rewriting the Rules of Lateral Movement
news.summary: The article examines how AI agents create new lateral movement risks in IAM by autonomously discovering and exploiting access paths that traditional identity governance models don't account for. Unlike human users or deterministic applications, AI agents can relentlessly probe and chain together existing permissions in unpredictable ways, challenging conventional least-privilege and access review frameworks.

news.title: Fake LastPass Authenticator Installer Abuses Microsoft-Signed Driver to Kill Antivirus and EDR
news.summary: Researchers at LastPass and Delphos Labs discovered a fake LastPass Authenticator installer on GitHub that deploys a Microsoft-signed Windows kernel driver to disable antivirus and EDR software before executing a password stealer. The malicious driver, signed through Microsoft's hardware-compatibility program, scored zero detections on VirusTotal, making it particularly difficult to detect.

news.title: Needham Just Upped Its Price Target on OKTA Stock. Here's Why.
news.summary: Needham analyst Mike Cikas raised his price target on Okta (OKTA) stock to $230. The update reflects a bullish outlook on Okta shares from the investment firm Needham.

news.title: Microsoft reminds admins to migrate Entra ID users to passkeys
news.summary: Microsoft has issued a reminder to admins that SMS first-factor sign-in for Entra ID will be retired starting February 2027. Admins are advised to migrate users to phishing-resistant authentication methods, such as passkeys, to prevent sign-in disruptions.

news.title: SAML: A fractal of bad design
news.summary: The article critiques SAML as a poorly designed authentication protocol that should be retired in favor of modern alternatives. The piece examines SAML's origins in academic and corporate IT environments and argues against its continued use as SaaS adoption grows.

news.title: Group Policy hijacked: PAYLOAD ransomware weaponizes Active Directory GPO
news.summary: Kaspersky's GERT team analyzed a PAYLOAD ransomware attack that weaponized Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to propagate without traditional encryption or binaries. The attack abused AD's GPO management mechanisms, highlighting how core identity infrastructure can be exploited for lateral movement and malicious policy distribution.

news.title: Claude Opus 5 Helped Researchers Take Over OpenAI Staff Accounts via Chained Flaws
news.summary: Security researchers at Hacktron used Claude Opus 5 to chain two vulnerabilities—a bug in OpenAI's help forum software and a weakness in OpenAI's login system—to take over ChatGPT and Codex accounts of OpenAI employees and access an internal code repository. The attack exploited weaknesses in OpenAI's authentication and account management infrastructure.

news.title: Okta Stock Is Up 132% Since March. Is the Stock Already Priced In?
news.summary: Okta's stock has risen 132.5% since mid-March, with a 21% single-day jump following a fiscal Q2 earnings beat. Analyst ratings currently stand at 25 buys, 9 outperforms, 10 holds, and 1 underperform.

news.title: Identity Visibility in 2026: The Foundation of Identity Security
news.summary: An article explains the concept of identity visibility as a foundational element of modern identity security, referencing breach data such as Verizon's DBIR to support its relevance. The piece covers what identity visibility means in IAM contexts and addresses challenges posed by cloud and multicloud environments.

news.title: SolarWinds Patches ARM Hard-Coded Key Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
news.summary: SolarWinds has patched a high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-28326, CVSS 8.8) in its Access Rights Manager (ARM) product that allowed unauthenticated remote code execution via a hard-coded key. The flaw affected all versions of Access Rights Manager 2026.2 and prior.

news.title: MFA Won't Save You From OAuth Consent Abuse
news.summary: The article addresses a specific security gap where OAuth consent abuse can bypass MFA protections entirely. It argues that effective defense requires OAuth governance controls including least-privilege scopes, consent monitoring, and rapid token revocation capabilities.

news.title: SailPoint’s (SAIL) Falcon Next-Gen SIEM Arrangement Fits Its Broader Identity Security Push
news.summary: SailPoint expanded its strategic alliance with CrowdStrike, integrating with CrowdStrike's Falcon Next-Gen SIEM platform. The partnership connects SailPoint's identity governance capabilities with CrowdStrike's security operations tooling.

news.title: Jim Cramer Says AI Could Make Okta’s Security Software More Essential
news.summary: Jim Cramer mentioned Okta on the September 16 episode of Mad Money, stating that AI is not making the identity-security company obsolete. The segment was a brief commentary on Okta's relevance in the context of AI risk concerns, without announcing any specific product, policy, or business development.

news.title: Why Shares of Okta Stock Shot Up 10% This Week
news.summary: Okta's stock price rose 10% this week following solid earnings results. The increase coincided with broader gains across cybersecurity stocks.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited with accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to keep up with testing and deploying the volume of fixes.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach, which affects a widely-used identity verification platform.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based access to Snowflake accounts, resulting in the theft of data including AT&T call and text records for over 100 million customers.
